sloka: एतस्मिन् एव काले तु चूली नाम महाद्युतिः ।ऊर्ध्व रेताः शुभाचारो ब्राह्मम् तप उपागमत् ॥१-३३-११॥
transliteration: etasmin eva kāle tu cūlī nāma mahādyutiḥ ।ūrdhva retāḥ śubhācāro brāhmam tapa upāgamat ॥1-33-11॥

translations.english: At that time a great and virtuous ascetic named Chuli living in celebacy was performing austerities in pursuit of the knowledge of Brahman.
